purpose: Resolve declared employer identity to SIREN/SIRET with explainable confidence before enrichment.

decision_tree.description: Use source-provided SIRET when syntactically valid and confirmed by authoritative lookup.
Use source-provided SIREN when syntactically valid, then choose establishment only with location evidence.
Match normalized declared company name with exact postal code or city when only one candidate remains.
Match enseigne/trade name to legal entity only when authoritative candidate links the trade name and location.
Use tolerant name similarity only with corroborating location or activity evidence.
Recruitment agencies, anonymous employers and inferred clients are never auto-matched without legal evidence.

reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_EXPLICIT_SIRET: Source provided a syntactically valid SIRET confirmed by authoritative lookup.
reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_EXPLICIT_SIREN: Source provided a syntactically valid SIREN confirmed by authoritative lookup.
reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_EXACT_NAME_LOCATION: Normalized name and location leave a single candidate.
reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_TRADE_NAME_LOCATION: Trade name or enseigne is linked to one legal entity at the location.
reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_TOLERANT_AMBIGUOUS: Tolerant match has some evidence but requires review.
reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_AGENCY_NO_CLIENT_PROOF: Intermediary detected; client cannot be inferred.
reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_HIDDEN_COMPANY: Employer name is hidden or masked.
reason_codes.G8N_MATCH_CLOSED_ESTABLISHMENT_REVIEW: Candidate establishment appears closed or stale.
